LIFE SKILLS WORKSHEETS · AGES 4–5

Life Skills & Good Habits worksheets — free printables for little hands.

Everyday skills on real activity sheets: wash your hands, tidy up, be kind, move your body, the magic words and asking for help. Download the original sheet, print it, or do it on screen in Class 32 first.

Wash Your Hands WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsClean hands before eating, a toothbrush for every child and a breakfast that is really healthy. View Worksheet → Tidy Up WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsEvery toy has a home — teddy, car, ball and blocks go back where they belong. View Worksheet → Be Kind WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsKind words, feeling faces and taking turns — the everyday habits of a good friend. View Worksheet → Move Your Body WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsRun, jump and stretch — spot safe movement, match the poses and choose active play. View Worksheet → Please and Thank You WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsThe magic words — please, thank you and excuse me, matched to the right moment. View Worksheet → Ask for Help WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsAsking a trusted grown-up is a skill — practise the words and pick the right helper. View Worksheet →

6 of the planned 30 sheets are ready now — the ones whose artwork has been uploaded. The remaining 24 appear here the day their artwork lands; nothing is published before it can be printed honestly.
